authority: brite-salesforce/CLAUDE.md and brite-salesforce ADR-016 (promotion topology, Amendment E) DEFINE Brite deploy discipline. This file MIRRORS that definition outward so agents in other repos inherit it. On any conflict brite-salesforce wins and this file is what is stale.
consumers: plugins/revops commands in this repo (read via scripts/promotion_topology.py)
brite-salesforce PreToolUse deploy-policy hook (BC-19519) — reads this JSON directly, no Python dependency
contract: The JSON is the contract. `protected_aliases` and `dev_org.alias_pattern` are the two fields a policy hook needs; everything else is explanatory. Add orgs by adding an `orgs[]` entry AND its alias (plus every `aka`) to `protected_aliases` when `enforcement` is not `allow`.

enforcement_levels.block: A local `sf` deploy to this alias must be refused. The org is CI-deployed only.
enforcement_levels.warn: A local `sf` deploy to this alias is legacy but not yet refused. Warn and point at the replacement.
enforcement_levels.allow: A local `sf` deploy to this alias is the intended inner-loop path.

dev_org.description: Per-developer sandbox. The only Salesforce org a developer deploys to directly from a laptop. Resolve the developer's own org rather than defaulting to one — see scripts/promotion_topology.py --resolve-dev-org.

orgs.description: Shared integration org. Changes reach it by merging a PR into the `integration` branch, never by a laptop deploy. Replaces the shared brite-sandbox.
User-acceptance org. Vocabulary is reserved now; the promote-to-uat command is ADR-026 Phase 2 and does not exist yet.

Production. brite-salesforce ADR-016 section 6 and Amendment E retired the raw local prod deploy: CI is the only normal path. The documented last resort is a guarded validate to quick-deploy, run by /revops:emergency-deploy-to-production.

The old single shared sandbox that did three jobs at once. Inner-loop work moves to the developer's own brite-dev-<name>; shared integration moves to brite-integration. Still `warn` rather than `block` so in-flight work is not stranded mid-migration.

local_deploy_allowed.note: An alias matching no entry here and no `orgs[]` entry is unknown. Treat unknown as blocked, not as allowed — fail closed.
